verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent with VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains connectors, so inline completions are a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only describes a terminal TUI agent workflow (editing files, running the toolchain, presenting diffs) and never mentions as-you-type completions or next-edit suggestions. The editor connectors are not described as providing completions, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
